cast.name: Sethe
cast.role: the mother at 124 Bluestone Road, who killed her baby daughter rather than see her returned to slavery
cast.look: a Black woman in her late twenties, slim and strong, dark brown skin, hair tied back in a cloth, a faded plain cotton dress, a long pale scar of a chokecherry tree across her upper back

cast.name: Denver
cast.role: Sethe's daughter, raised in isolation at 124 Bluestone Road, the one who walks out to the steps for help
cast.look: a young Black woman around twenty, thin, dark brown skin, hair in braids, a simple grey dress with a shawl

cast.name: Paul D
cast.role: a man who was enslaved at Sweet Home with Sethe, who returns to 124 Bluestone Road in 1873
cast.look: a Black man in his late thirties, broad shouldered, dark brown skin, short hair, a worn brown work coat over a plain shirt

cast.name: Baby Suggs
cast.role: Sethe's mother-in-law, an old preacher who gathers people in the Clearing
cast.look: a Black woman in her sixties, small and stooped, grey hair under a white headscarf, a long dark dress and apron

cast.name: Beloved
cast.role: a young woman who appears at the house, who may be the returned daughter or a ghost
cast.look: a young Black woman in her early twenties, pale dark skin, long hair loose, a plain white dress, barefoot

cast.name: The schoolteacher
cast.role: the white man who runs Sweet Home, who records the enslaved people in a ledger of their traits
cast.look: a white man in his fifties, neat dark suit, starched collar, a black tie, clean-shaven, a notebook in his hand

cast.name: Stamp Paid
cast.role: a man who ferried escaping enslaved people across the river and later shows Paul D a newspaper clipping
cast.look: a Black man in his fifties, lean, dark brown skin, a grey waistcoat and an old hat
